headline: ₱3.4M Total Portfolio Revenue
concentration: Top 3 accounts drive 32% of revenue (₱1.1M), while NCR alone contributes 39% — a dual concentration risk across both customer and geography dimensions.
disparity: Enterprise segment out-earns SME by 3.2x (₱2.6M vs ₱0.8M). The top 3 accounts collectively earn 13x more than the bottom 5 — indicating extreme revenue stratification.
action: RECOMMENDATION: De-risk through (1) regional expansion into Visayas/Mindanao, (2) SME upsell programs targeting accounts with >30 orders but <₱100K revenue, and (3) enterprise retention investment in the top 5 accounts that represent >40% of the book.
